tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Outermost page ground behind everything; the space between panels.

tokens.name: hull
tokens.usage: Default page surface and section bands.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised console panels: project cards, readout boxes, status rows.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and panel edges only (1.4:1). Never the sole edge of a control; controls use muted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on void, hull and panel (14.7:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, timestamps, control borders (6.2:1 or better).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The brand hue: primary actions, the active nav mark, headline accents, links. Amber console light.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a signal fill (5.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: beacon
tokens.usage: Secondary accent: live-data readouts, 'in transit' / active-roll markers, focus rings.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Status NOMINAL / service up / project shipped. Always paired with its glyph and word.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: Status DOWN / failing check. Always paired with its glyph and word; never decorative.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Gentium Book Plus: the darker 'book' cut, for titles. Gentium has 400 and 700 only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The landing hero only; one per page.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Gentium Plus: the default face of the whole site. Its x-height is modest, so running text starts at 18px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A Nix package set and the tooling that keeps it moving.
styles.usage: Running text, summaries and long-form write-ups. The site default.

styles.name: accent
styles.usage: Calligraphic italic for taglines, pull quotes and hero sub-lines (Gentium Book Plus Italic). Successor to the Artifex CF Bold Italic role.

styles.name: body-italic
styles.usage: Emphasis and asides inside running text (Gentium Plus Italic).

groups.name: Readout
groups.note: The one exception to Gentium: machine values stay monospaced so digits align in tables and live readouts.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Live values: versions, uptime, counts, branch names.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase panel labels and status words. Never for sentences.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The grid unit; gaps between a glyph and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside dense readouts; label to value.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Status chips, inputs, small readouts. The console default: nearly square.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status lamps (the dot beside a status word) only.
